binConfigPanel.overflowDescription: When this bin is full or at its copy limit, cards that match it go to the bin you pick instead of pausing the scan. Only bins without rules of their own can be picked, and a bin can't have its own rules while it's an overflow.
binConfigPanel.overflowNoOptions: No free bins. Clear a bin's rules to use it as an overflow.
binConfigPanel.overflowTargetNotice_one: This bin is the overflow for bin {{bins}}. Cards land here when that bin is full, so it can't have rules of its own. Change the overflow on bin {{bins}} to give this bin rules again.
binConfigPanel.overflowTargetNotice_other: This bin is the overflow for bins {{bins}}. Cards land here when those bins are full, so it can't have rules of its own. Change their overflow to give this bin rules again.
binConfigPanel.disabledDescription: Cards never go here. They move on to the next bin that matches, or the catch-all.
binConfigPanel.disabledNotice: This bin is disabled. Its rules are kept, but no cards are sent to it until you turn it back on.
binConfigPanel.overrideDescription: When these rules match, this bin takes priority over ordinary bins. If several override bins match, priority 1 wins over 2, and so on. Override bins on the same priority send the card to whichever is emptiest. For example, use Price ≥ 1 here to override color bins for cards worth $1 or more.
binConfigPanel.maxCopiesDescription: Once this bin holds this many cards that share the chosen value (since it was last emptied), more of them skip it and go to the next bin whose rules match, or the catch-all. Limiting by name also counts different printings of the same card together.
binConfigPanel.needCatchAllError: At least one bin must be catch-all.
binConfigPanel.catchAllDescription: Cards that don't match any other bin will go here.
binConfigPanel.lowMatchDescription: Scans below this match percent come here even when another bin's rules match them, override bins included.
binConfigPanel.autoAssignWaiting: Waiting for a new {{field}} to appear
binConfigPanel.scanOnlyLocked: Scan only is on. Scanned and unidentified cards go to the bins picked in Sorting mode. Turn it off to configure bins.
binConfigPanel.modeChangePending: Save or discard the pending mode change above before editing bins.
binConfigPanel.priorityDescription: 1 is the highest priority. When several overrides match a card, the lowest number wins, and overrides on the same level send it to the emptiest of their bins. Overrides without a level come last, in bin order.
binConfigPanel.priorityOrder: Overrides are checked in this order: {{order}}
binConfigPanel.repackPriorityDescription: Cards go to the open pack with the lowest priority first, so a priority 1 bin fills before a priority 2 bin. Bins on Auto fill after every bin with a priority, in bin order.
binConfigPanel.catchAllRulesDescription: Cards matching these rules come here even when another bin's rules match them, like a color card that snuck into a colorless pile. Leave empty to only catch cards no other bin takes.
binConfigPanel.sortSourceRulesDescription: Cards that match the rules below.
binConfigPanel.sortSourcePickListDescription: Only cards on the list below, like a decklist. Checked before every other bin's rules.
binConfigPanel.rulesSectionDescription: Cards that match go to this bin.
binConfigPanel.maxCardsDescription: Sorting pauses when this bin holds this many cards, even if it has room. Leave empty to use the bin's physical size.

binList.needCatchAll: One bin must be set as catch-all.

toasts.scanOnlyFailed: Failed to update scan only settings
toasts.emptyBinFailed: Failed to mark bin as emptied

gameSortPanel.heading: Sort by game
gameSortPanel.description: Identifies each card against this game and the games you pick, then gives each game its own bin. Cards are sorted but not saved, so you can scan each pile into its own collection afterwards.
gameSortPanel.pickGames: Pick at least one other game. Until you do, only this game's cards are recognized.
gameSortPanel.hint: Cards that aren't recognized go to the catch-all. Each extra game makes scans a little slower.

autoAssignPanel.heading: Auto-detect sorting
autoAssignPanel.description: Learns bin assignments as you scan: the first time a new value appears for the field below, it claims the next open bin. Repeats route back automatically, and once every bin is taken, new values fall to the catch-all.
autoAssignPanel.resetConfirmDescription: Clears every bin's learned value in this preset. New scans will refill them from scratch.

scanOnlyPanel.heading: Scan only
scanOnlyPanel.description: Skips every sorting rule. Scanned cards go to one bin and unidentified cards to another (or the same one). Turn this off to configure bins manually.

repackPanel.heading: Build repacks
repackPanel.description: Every non-catch-all bin builds its own pack at the same time from the slots you define below (e.g. 3 commons, 2 uncommons, 1 rare). Anything that doesn't fit an open slot in any bin goes to the catch-all. Once a bin's pack is complete it stops receiving cards - empty it to start a new pack there while the others keep filling.
repackPanel.uniqueByDescription: Stops a pack from getting two cards that share this. A card that would be a duplicate skips that bin (it can still start a different pack that doesn't have it yet). No duplicate names also counts different printings of the same card as duplicates.
repackPanel.multiplePacksDescription: When a bin finishes a pack, it starts a new one on top of it and keeps going until the bin is full. A bin only starts a new pack if it has room for the whole pack, so packs are never cut short.
repackPanel.siftDescription: Cards that match the rules below go to the first bin instead of a pack, so you can pull out cards you want to keep (by value, rarity, set or anything else) while every other bin builds packs from the rest.
repackPanel.siftHint: Cards matching these rules go to bin {{bin}}. Every other bin builds packs from the rest.
repackPanel.siftNoBin: Sifting needs at least one enabled bin besides the catch-all.
repackPanel.notInPlan: Building repacks is not part of your plan.

skipSavingPanel.heading: Don't save cards
skipSavingPanel.description: Cards are identified and sorted into bins as usual, but nothing is added to the collection. Scans still count toward your daily limit.

resortPanel.heading: Re-sort saved cards
resortPanel.description: Each scan moves a copy that is already in this collection into its new bin instead of adding another copy. The copy keeps its foil and condition and leaves its old storage location. Cards not in the collection yet are added as usual.

chaosPanel.heading: Chaos sort
chaosPanel.description: Ignores the rules and fills the bins one after another, moving on when a bin is full. When you empty a bin, pick the storage location you put it in, and every card is recorded there in order.
chaosPanel.binSizeDescription: Moves to the next bin after this many cards. Leave empty to fill each bin to its calibrated size.
chaosPanel.notInPlan: Chaos sort is not part of your plan.

alphabetPanel.heading: Sort alphabetically
alphabetPanel.description: Sorts by the first letter of each card's name, one letter per bin. With 8 sorting bins, the first pass sorts A to H and sends everything else to the catch-all. Empty the bins, put the catch-all cards back in the feeder, and move to the next letters until the alphabet is done. To go further, use Sort deeper on any pile to sort it by its next letter (AA, AB, AC…).
alphabetPanel.needBins: Alphabetical sort needs at least one bin besides the catch-all.
alphabetPanel.prefixRange: Sorting the {{prefix}} pile by its next letter: {{from}} to {{to}}. Everything else goes to the catch-all.
alphabetPanel.passRange: Sorting names starting with {{from}} to {{to}}. Everything else goes to the catch-all.
alphabetPanel.nextPassHint: When this pass is done, take the cards out of every bin, put the catch-all cards back in the feeder, then move to the next letters.
alphabetPanel.lastPassHint: This is the last pass. Anything left in the catch-all afterwards has a name that doesn't start with a letter.
alphabetPanel.confirmTitle: Move to a new set of letters?
alphabetPanel.confirmDescription: Make sure every bin is empty and the catch-all cards are back in the feeder. All bins will be marked as emptied.
alphabetPanel.nextPileHint: When this pass is done, take the cards out of every bin and keep each pile in order. Next up: the {{prefix}} pile.
alphabetPanel.confirmPileDescription: Empty every bin, keeping each pile in order, then put the {{prefix}} pile in the feeder. All bins will be marked as emptied.
alphabetPanel.pileDoneHint: This is the last pass for the {{prefix}} pile. Start over to go back to the whole alphabet.

presetWorkflows.missingPresetDescription: This stage's preset was deleted. Pick another preset for it above.
presetWorkflows.newDescription: Run existing presets one after another. Pick the first stage now and add the rest from the multi-stage page.
presetWorkflows.firstStageDescription: The preset that sorts the pile first. You add the next stages on the multi-stage page.
presetWorkflows.pageDescription: Runs your presets one after another. Sort the whole pile with stage 1, put the cards back in the feeder, then move to the next stage. Stages after the first re-sort the cards you already saved, unless you turn that off.
presetWorkflows.deleteDescription: Delete "{{name}}"? The presets it uses are kept.
presetWorkflows.renameDescription: Enter a new name for this multi-stage preset.
presetWorkflows.notFoundDescription: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another game.
presetWorkflows.editingInactiveDescription: This isn't the preset the sorter is running. Changes apply wherever this preset is used, including its multi-stage presets.
presetWorkflows.saveFirst: Save your changes before switching stages.
presetWorkflows.confirmMoveDescription: Empty every bin first, setting storage locations if you want them. Then put the cards for {{name}} in the feeder. Bins still holding cards are marked as emptied.
presetWorkflows.stopFirst: Stop the scanner before switching stages.

binRuleTransfer.title: Copy or move rules from {{bin}}
binRuleTransfer.description: Puts this bin's sorting rules on another bin. Moving also clears them from this bin.
binRuleTransfer.replaceWarning: {{bin}} already has rules. They will be replaced.
binRuleTransfer.saveFirst: Save or discard your changes first.

sortTest.title: Test sort
sortTest.description: A random card from the database runs through {{name}}, the same way the scanner would sort it. Nothing is saved and the sorter doesn't move.
sortTest.cardDescription: This card runs through {{name}}, the same way the scanner would sort it now. Nothing is saved and the sorter doesn't move.
sortTest.noGameDescription: Choose a collection with a game to test its rules.
sortTest.noCardsDescription: This game has no cards in the database yet.
sortTest.scannedTo: When it was scanned, this card also went to {{bin}}.
sortTest.scannedElsewhere: When it was scanned, this card went to {{scanned}}, not {{tested}}. The preset may have changed since then, or a full bin, overflow or pick list sent it elsewhere. This test doesn't look at how full the bins are.

reasons.rules: Bin {{bin}}'s rules match this card, and it's the first bin that does.
reasons.override: Bin {{bin}} is an override bin and its rules match, so it wins over other matching bins.
reasons.catchAllRules: The catch-all's own rules match this card.
reasons.noRuleMatched: No bin's rules match this card, so it goes to the catch-all.
reasons.overflow: Bin {{matched}} matches, and its cards overflow into bin {{bin}}.
reasons.autoAssign: Auto-assign gives this card's value its own bin: bin {{bin}}.
reasons.scanOnly: Scan-only mode sends every identified card to bin {{bin}}.
reasons.chaos: Chaos mode fills bins in turn, so this card goes to bin {{bin}}.
reasons.alphabet: Names starting with {{letter}} go to bin {{bin}} in this pass.
reasons.alphabetCatchAll: This name isn't in the current letters, so it goes to the catch-all.
reasons.repack: Repack mode puts this card in a pack in bin {{bin}}.
reasons.noBin: No bin takes this card. Add a catch-all so cards like this have somewhere to go.

toasts.invalid: That isn't a valid bin rules file
toasts.wrongGame: These bin rules are for a different game
toasts.binsSkipped_one: {{count}} bin was skipped because this sorter has fewer bins.
toasts.binsSkipped_other: {{count}} bins were skipped because this sorter has fewer bins.

modes.untilFoundDescription: Pulls copies until the quantity on the list is found, then crosses the card off. Later copies sort normally.
modes.allDescription: Pulls every copy of every card on the list, however many there are.

pickList.decklistHint: One card per line, with an optional quantity. Set codes, collector numbers and section headers from Moxfield, Arena or MTGO exports are ignored. Double-faced cards match either face.
pickList.importEmpty: No cards found in that file. Check that the first row has column names like Product Name and Quantity.
pickList.importSkipped_one: {{count}} row without a card name was skipped.
pickList.importSkipped_other: {{count}} rows without a card name were skipped.
